svg.title: ChamberSafe: digitized visible back-face traces, not raw data
svg.desc: Visible raster envelopes and horizontal-stroke centers calibrated from original figure ticks. Blue baseline 20-second label peaks near 0.317 degrees Celsius. Orange hot 10-second label peaks near 0.214 degrees Celsius. Gaps are not interpolated. Time is relative to each log, not flame ignition.
svg.text: ChamberSafe · digitized figure, not raw data
Approximate back-face temperature rise · original figure calibration retained
Dark marks: visible horizontal-stroke centers. Pale bands: visible pixel envelopes.
Blank centers / gaps are unresolved, merged or occluded; no smoothing or interpolation.
Time from start of each log (s) · NOT flame-on time
Table 6 reports hot peak 0.241 °C. The ≈0.027 °C difference remains unresolved.
